Who We Are

Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone.

At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn.

What We Are Looking For

Aurora hires talented people with diverse backgrounds who are ready to help build a transportation ecosystem that will make our roads safer, get crucial goods where they need to go, and make mobility more efficient and accessible for all.

We’re searching for an AI Engineer Intern. This is a role on the fast-moving AI Platform team, where we build the platform that powers AI-initiatives across Aurora, including agents, evaluations, and coding tools.

In this role you will



- Collaborate with engineers, PMs, and operations specialists across Aurora to identify pain points in existing processes or workflows
- Implement AI agents and evaluations on Aurora’s AI Platform to directly address these pain points
- Accelerate Aurora’s development of AI tools by generalizing learnings from implementing agents

Required Qualifications



- Experience with modern programming languages such as Python and C++
- Experience with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode
- Foundational understanding of Agentic AI principles and concepts
- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or related field

Desirable Qualifications



- Experience with cloud technologies such as AWS, GCP, or Azure
- Experience with agentic frameworks such as LangGraph/DeepAgents or Claude Agent SDK
- Experience with agentic evaluation platforms and frameworks such as Langsmith and Harbor
- Experience in Project/Program Management

Compensation

The hourly pay rate for this internship in Mountain View or Seattle is:



- $52.00 per hour for interns pursuing a bachelor’s degree

The hourly pay rate for this internship in Pittsburgh is:



- $47.00 per hour for interns pursuing a bachelor’s degree

Working at Aurora

At Aurora, we bring together extraordinarily talented and experienced people united by the strength of our values. We operate with integrity, set outrageous goals, and build a culture where we win together — all without any jerks.

We believe in-person work increases collaboration, empathy, and our ability to lead effectively. As a result, Aurorans are expected to work from the office at least 3 days per week, with some roles requiring more frequent in-office presence, up to 5 days per week, based on operational needs.

Our Careers page provides insight into what it is like to work at Aurora, and you can find all the latest updates in our Newsroom.

Our commitment to safety

At the core of everything we do is our commitment to safety. Building best-in-class self-driving technology will take time, and we believe that each employee at Aurora has a role in contributing to safety, every step of the way. Aurora expects commitment to our safety policies from every employee, and seeks candidates who take an active responsibility, can contribute to building an atmosphere of trust, and invest in the organization’s long-term success by prioritizing working safely, no matter what.

Our commitment to inclusion

Aurora considers candidates without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy status, parent or caregiver status, ancestry, political affiliation, veteran and/or military status, physical or mental disability, or any other status protected by federal or state law. Aurora considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at careersiteaccommodations@aurora.tech.

For California applicants, information collected and processed as part of your application and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Aurora’s California Employment Privacy Policy.
fit_why: Strong Python and agent overlap; AI platform work fits, but C++ and evals are gaps

2027 Summer Internship Program

Would you like to work for an organization committed to your professional development and personal success? John Burns Research and Consulting is an award-winning “Best Place to Work” that invests in our people through learning opportunities, professional experiences, and peer mentorship.

John Burns Research and Consulting is looking for talented students who are passionate, articulate, likable, and smart to provide the most trusted source of U.S. housing analysis and help our clients make the most informed decisions possible.

The Burns Internship provides meaningful work experiences and ongoing support and guidance to ensure you have valuable experience and prepare you for a professional career.

This Data Science intern will be working with our Data Science and Forecasting groups. This is an in-person internship in our Irvine, California office.

Program Details

As an intern, you'll begin the summer orientation delivered by experienced team members, similar to the training received by new employees. You will be working on real-time client projects, as well as a capstone project. Your capstone project will be a significant, strategic project that aligns with our real business needs and initiatives. At the end of your 10-week internship, you will do a final presentation of your capstone project, and what you learned throughout your internship.

There will be two possible start dates for our 2027 internship program:



- May 26th – August 6th
- June 16th – August 27th

(If the dates don’t work 100% for you, please still apply, and we can discuss.) 



- Interns will work 40 hours per week, in our Irvine, California office.
- Salary is $25/hour.
- Positions will be posted for students to apply in October, and each position will be posted for two weeks.

- Positions will be posted until Friday, November 6th, 2026
- Offers will be extended by Friday, December 18th, 2026
What You Will Learn



- Understanding our organization, industry, clients, and professional experience by working with our team members on their daily tasks. 
- The opportunity to develop professional and technical skills necessary for success in the business world by working with teams within our company. 

Projects Our Interns May Be Working On



- Curating data and building features for forecasting models
- Working within our coding environment to explore statistical significance of features
- Contribute to building forecasting models over various time horizons
- Helping with building out models/tools for communicating the explainability and interpretability of our models

How Do You Qualify?

The Burns Internship Program is designed for high-performing students. We prefer candidates who meet the following criteria:



- Cumulative GPA: 3.3
- Major GPA: 3.3 
- Rising seniors and graduate students (Graduating Spring 2027 – Spring 2028)
- Preferred Fields of study: computer science, statistics, mathematics, data science, or related field
- Proficiency in coding (python, pandas, SQL)
- Interest or experience in economics as pertains to the housing market
- Knowledge of building predictive models (time-series methods, machine learning methods)
- Willing to work with messy data
- Basic Excel skills
- Detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to manage multiple tasks
- Collaborative team player
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Keen eye for details
- A strong work ethic
- A great attitude
- A willingness to learn new skills
- Exceptional time management skills to effectively prioritize tasks and meet deadlines

To apply for the position, you must submit a cover letter and resume. Please explain why you are interested in this internship program and what you hope to gain from it.

Join our team at John Burns Research and Consulting, LLC, a leading provider of independent subscription research and customized consulting services for the U.S. housing industry. Our founder, John Burns, started the company in 2001 with the aim of revolutionizing the housing market analysis. Today, we have a team of highly passionate research analysts and consultants nationwide who work together to provide the most trusted source of U.S. housing analysis and consulting services.

At John Burns Research and Consulting, LLC, we are proud of our award-winning culture, which includes recognition as Great Places to Work, Gallup Employee Engagement, Certified Evergreen by the Tugboat Institute, and Great Places to Work. If you want to be part of a well-established, dynamic, and high-performing team that takes it to the next level, this is the perfect opportunity for you.
fit_why: Python, pandas, SQL, forecasting and ML fit; data science intern role

Nutrien is a leading provider of crop inputs and services, and our business results make a positive impact on the world. Our purpose, Feeding the Future, is the reason we come to work each day. We’re guided by our culture of care and our core values: We put safety first. We act with integrity. We are stronger together. We deliver with excellence.

Through the collective expertise of our nearly 26,000 employees, we operate a world-class network of production, distribution, and ag retail facilities. We efficiently serve growers' needs and strive to provide a more profitable, sustainable, and secure future for all stakeholders.  Help us raise the expectation of what an agriculture company can be and grow your career with Nutrien. 

Job Summary

An exciting co-op opportunity awaits a motivated student at our Calgary or Saskatoon corporate office beginning January for an approximate 12-month term. This is a temporary, full-time, hourly-paid position and is open to current students who will be returning to their studies once this work term is complete. 

What You'll Do



- Help build and improve software delivery pipelines so teams can test and release changes faster and more reliably
- Support cloud-based applications by improving monitoring, logging, alerts, and day-to-day operational tools with the team
- Work with developers, operations team members, and agile delivery teams on planning, automation, and tools using platforms like Amazon Web Services, GitHub, TypeScript, and C#, with AI pair programming used as part of the team’s day-to-day work

What You'll Bring



- Currently enrolled in a 2 to 4 year Computer Science or Software Engineering degree or equivalent related program with a graduation date of August 2027 or later

Ready to make an impact with us? Apply today!   

The estimated salary that Indeed, Glassdoor and LinkedIn lists does not represent Nutrien's compensation structure. Nutrien is an equal opportunity employer.  We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.  

This job will remain posted until filled. In accordance with Nutrien policies, you will be required to undergo a background check, and may be required to undergo a substance test. While we appreciate all applications we receive, only candidates under consideration will be contacted. Applicants must meet minimum age requirements, as permitted by law. 

Please be advised that pre-screen interviews may be transcribed (there will be no audio or video recording) and that artificial intelligence tools may be used to summarize the transcript of the discussion. These tools will not be used to make or influence hiring decisions. Biometric identifiers and biometric information will not be captured. If you wish to request an alternative process or a reasonable accommodation, please submit a request through our Contact Us form or call 1-800-667-0403 in Canada and 1-800-667-3930 in the US to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

Our Recruitment Process: Application > Resume Review > Pre-screen/Interview > Offer > Pre-Employment Conditions > Welcome to Nutrien 

To stay connected to us and for the latest job postings and news, follow us on:  LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.
fit_why: Cloud DevOps co-op; his web and Docker/CI overlap, but AWS and C# are gaps

jd:
About the team 
Zillow's Data Science and Analytics organization turns complex data into insights that inform decisions across the company. As an intern, you'll join the team and explore how data can help us understand customer behavior, measure outcomes, and find ways to improve the customer experience. You'll work with data scientists and cross-functional partners, building your analytical skills while bringing a fresh perspective to real business questions.

Interns may focus on areas such as:
Business: build reporting, models, and insights that help specific Zillow organizations assess current initiatives and find opportunities to innovate.
Marketing: develop experimentation-first strategies for consumer and business marketing, and measure how each channel performs.
Product: analyze how people use our web and app products so we can deliver a better experience for everything home.
Pricing: help develop pricing strategies that deliver strong value for customers such as Premier Agents, lenders, and landlords.
Tools: turn the large volume of data Zillow collects every day into data products that help partners make informed decisions. 
 About the role 
 At Zillow, interns do meaningful work that contributes to the business from day one. As a Data Science Intern, you’ll apply the quantitative and programming skills you’re building in school to a scoped, real-world project. With guidance from your manager and team, you’ll work through the analytical process—from defining a question and preparing data to interpreting results and sharing recommendations. 
 
Our nine-week summer internship program, running June 14 through August 13, 2027, gives students the opportunity to bring their ideas and perspectives to real projects alongside Zillow teams. Interns build hands-on experience, connect with mentors and leaders, and take part in learning and community experiences with their intern cohort. 
 
Our 2027 internships are based in Seattle and follow a hybrid schedule, with interns generally working together in person Tuesday through Thursday. Eligible interns will receive a stipend to help offset summer housing and relocation costs.
 
 During your internship, you will have opportunities to: 
 
• Partner with your manager and stakeholders to turn an open-ended business question into an analytical plan with clear goals and deliverables. 
• Use SQL and Python/R to explore, prepare, and validate data, documenting assumptions and flagging data-quality issues. 
• Analyze patterns in customer behavior or business performance to uncover insights and potential opportunities. 
• Apply statistical methods, such as regression, hypothesis testing, or experiment analysis (including A/B tests and pilots), as fits your project. 
• Help define and interpret metrics that connect your analysis to customer and business outcomes, and support ongoing performance tracking. 
• Create clear visualizations and reproducible analyses that make your findings useful to others. 
• Work with engineers, product managers, marketers, and other teammates to build a shared approach to analyzing and communicating insights. 
• Communicate your approach, results, recommendations, and limitations to technical and nontechnical audiences. 
• Document your work and deliver a final presentation and handoff so the team can build on your findings. 
 
This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at an existing ZG corporate office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within reasonable commuting distance of their designated ZG office. ZG has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute. 
 
In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $104,000.00 - $166,000.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations. 
 
Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. 
 Who you are 
 
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, Finance, or a related quantitative field. You’re targeting a graduation date before December 2028. 
• Have a foundation in probability, statistics, and data analysis through coursework, research, or projects. 
• Can use Python or R, or a similar programming language, to manipulate data and perform analysis. 
• Have familiarity with SQL and relational data, or a demonstrated ability and willingness to learn. 
• Enjoy asking questions, investigating patterns, and bringing structure to ambiguous problems. 
• Approach analysis thoughtfully: you check assumptions, validate results, and distinguish what the data supports from what remains uncertain. 
• Can explain your thinking clearly and collaborate with people who bring different technical and non-technical backgrounds. 
• Are curious about using AI tools to support your work while maintaining independent judgment, validating outputs, and following data-handling guidelines.
 Experience from coursework, academic research, student organizations, and personal projects is welcome. Prior professional data science experience is not required.
 
 Helpful, but not required: 
 
• Exposure to A/B testing, experimental design, or causal inference. 
• Experience with data visualization tools or libraries. 
• Familiarity with regression, predictive modeling, or other statistical learning methods. 
• Experience organizing reproducible work using notebooks, version control, or clear technical documentation. 
 Get to know us 
 At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality. 

 How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.  

 Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list , reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow. 

 No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together. 

 Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly. 

 Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law. 

 Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
fit_why: Data science intern: stats, Python/R, SQL, A/B testing fits well

We believe power is a promise - a shared commitment to be there for others when it matters most. 

 For more than 65 years, we've turned big ideas into solutions that help protect homes, strengthen businesses and build a more resilient, efficient, sustainable energy future.

 Ready to Power a Smarter World with us?

 Position Overview
 Generac is seeking a highly motivated Master's-level Engineering Intern to join the AI Solutions team supporting Corporate Operations and Supply Chain. This internship offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of artificial intelligence, advanced analytics, manufacturing operations, and supply chain optimization.
 You will partner with business leaders, data scientists, engineers, and operational stakeholders to identify opportunities where AI, machine learning, automation, and digital technologies can improve efficiency, decision-making, quality, and customer outcomes. The role provides hands-on experience developing and evaluating innovative solutions that support digital transformation and operational excellence.

 Thi s position is required to work on site at our corporate headquarters in Waukesha, WI during scheduled work hours, 

 Essential Duties
 Support the development, testing, and implementation of AI-enabled solutions for manufacturing, supply chain, quality, and corporate operations.
 Analyze operational and supply chain data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for automation or process improvement.
 Assist in building data models, dashboards, predictive analytics, and decision-support tools using enterprise data.
 Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to gather business requirements and translate operational challenges into analytical solutions.
 Contribute to pilot projects involving machine learning, generative AI, optimization algorithms, process automation, and intelligent workflows.
 Research emerging AI technologies and industry practices relevant to manufacturing and supply chain environments.
 Prepare clear presentations and recommendations that summarize findings, potential business value, and implementation considerations.
 Document methodologies, results, and lessons learned to help scale successful solutions across the enterprise.

 Potential Project Areas
 •  Supply and demand planning optimization
 •  Supplier collaboration and procurement analytics
 •  Inventory forecasting and replenishment modeling
 •  Quality improvement through AI-driven insights
 •  Manufacturing process automation
 •  Generative AI for operational productivity
 •  Predictive maintenance analytics
 •  Advanced reporting and business intelligence
 
 Education 
 Currently pursuing master's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Data Science, Operations Research, Supply Chain Analytics, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.

 Knowledge, Skills & Abilities 
 Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills.
 Experience with statistical analysis, quantitative modeling, or data analysis.
 Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to varied audiences.
 Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across functions.

 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with Python, R, SQL, or a similar programming language.
 Exposure to machine learning, artificial intelligence, predictive analytics, or optimization.
 Familiarity with manufacturing, supply chain, or operations environments.
 Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or another visualization platform.
 Knowledge of simulation, operations research, or process-improvement methodologies.
 Experience working with large datasets or cloud-based analytics environments.
 “We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.”
